text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Bravo! Listen to the cheers! They're 
celebrating your victory!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I am sure that in admiration, everyone 
will work hard to surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
She has left a hoofprint of hope in the 
horse girl world. Thank you for that ride… 
and—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Nothing can top you two. The best trainer 
and the best horse girl!
